newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Snow chaos leaves Bulgarian villages without power.
newsitem.headline: Snow chaos leaves Bulgarian villages without power.

text.p: Snowstorms left 470 Bulgarian towns and villages without power for a second day on Friday but airports in Sofia and Varna reopened, state radio reported.
Several towns in the impoverished Balkan country had no fuel for snow-clearing vehicles.
The snow chaos was worst in the northeast of the country, where Varna's regional governor declared a state of emergency after Thursday's blizzards.
A special cabinet commission ordered emergency teams to get to work and advised people to stay at home until roads were cleared.
The radio said strong winds and snow were continuing over most of the country but the snow was less heavy than on Thursday and was forecast to stop on Saturday.
On Thursday, bad weather forced the plane of Bulgarian president-elect Petar Stoyanov, who was returning to Sofia after an official visit to Italy, to land in Bucharest.
